notes: Standard 2 paper, William Clarke College 2020 HSC Assessment Task 3 (AT3). Questions 6, 7, 8 each group unrelated items (a),(b),(c) so they are stored as 6(a), 6(b), 6(c), 7(a)... 8(b) following the split rule; the paper's label is kept as the top-level part (container part with no marks holds the intro text and any shared figure). Section II = 3+4+3+2+3+5+7+3 = 30. Bundled solutions are scanned handwritten teacher annotations (pages 13-25); r/w means right/wrong. MCQ option figures have empty option latex with figure_key. Q6(c) future-value table is cropped as a figure; Q2 and Q7(c)(i) tables are table data. Q7(c)(ii) blank number plane has no axis scale printed. Q6(b)(iii) shading is drawn in guidelines (same crop used for b.ii and b.iii). No printing typos noticed.
